phase1CompletionMeaning: Every pairing is accepted with a complete annual research curve or deferred as a whole with a reason. Completion is configuration/research synthesis, not prospective empirical validation or public-release approval.
scoreMeaning: Evidence-informed FinFindr seasonal pier opportunity under supportive temperature, using the unchanged core 1-10 rubric; not a measured catch probability or agency score.
method: Sparse month-day anchors, linear interpolation using actual calendar dates and December-January wrap, identical to the completed core architecture. Accepted pairings have a number every day; deferred pairings have none. No availability windows.
dateBoundaryMeaning: Representative mid-month anchors have approximately month-level evidence resolution. Interpolated daily/weekly decimals are arithmetic, not separately observed coefficients.
winterTreatment: Explicit low-confidence habitat/accessibility judgments combined with established local seasonal recurrence. Missing survey rows remain missing observations; they are not converted into zero catches. No universal winter floor, inactivity assumption or copied city curve.
calibrationPolicy: Ordinal bands follow the unchanged completed-core rubric. Half-point choices are coarse product judgments within bands, not statistical estimates. Regional biology may inform direction and weak-season priors only after local fishery admission; it cannot admit a city pairing or justify a strong peak by itself.
validationStatus: Research configuration complete; prospective accuracy, thermal-response work and public scientific gates remain outstanding in subsequent phases.
